1e40c542fdce8cd2: We talk endlessly about becoming a high-income economy, a regional digital hub and an Industry 4.0 nation.
We want AI, automation, robotics, smart manufacturing, semiconductors, biotechnology, the green economy and data-driven government. We have no shortage of plans or slogans.

But the Programme for International Student Assessment (Pisa 2025) report raises a question our leaders keep avoiding: are we building the human capacity to carry Malaysia forward, or watching the foundation crumble?
The findings are alarming.

Only 35% of Malaysian students reached baseline proficiency in mathematics, compared with 65% across the Organisation for Economic Cooperation and Development (OECD). In reading, the figure was 44% versus 69%. In science, 54% versus 74%.
These are the young Malaysians who will soon manage money, interpret health information, judge online claims, sign contracts and enter a labour market already being reshaped by AI.
We cannot claim to be ready for the Fourth Industrial Revolution when most teenagers have not mastered basic mathematics, reading and science.

This is not about turning every child into a scientist or coder. It is about ensuring every young person has the numeracy, literacy and critical-thinking skills needed to function in a modern economy.
But we are moving backwards.
Since 2018, Malaysian students’ proficiency in mathematics, reading and science has fallen by 20 to 24 percentage points.
Pisa does not measure everything. It cannot capture character or creativity. But dismissing it because the results are uncomfortable would be a mistake.
The assessment tests whether students can apply knowledge to real problems, reason through unfamiliar questions and communicate clearly — precisely the skills a knowledge economy needs.
What makes the results even harder to explain is that Malaysian students want to learn.

Eighty percent describe themselves as curious, compared with 73% across the OECD. Seventy-nine percent say they push harder when work gets difficult, compared with 60%. Only 7% consider school a waste of time, compared with 24% across the OECD.
So why are the outcomes so weak?
The failure is not theirs. It is the system’s.

Are we teaching students to think, or to memorise model answers? Are mistakes treated as part of learning, or something to fear? Do assessments reward understanding or just the ability to reproduce an expected text? And are teachers given the training, time and respect to teach differently?
We have avoided these questions for too long.

The lack of top performers is another warning sign. Only 0.5% reached the highest science levels and 0.6% the top mathematics levels. Almost none reached the highest reading band. OECD averages are 7%, 8% and 6%.
Malaysia needs a broad base of competence — but also exceptional minds capable of building tomorrow’s industries. We cannot keep importing talent while failing to develop enough of our own.
Then there is inequality.
Advantaged students outscored disadvantaged students by 82 points in science. Socioeconomic background accounted for 16% of the performance gap, compared with 12% across the OECD.

A child’s future should not depend on family income, postcode or internet access. Talent exists in every kampung, estate, flat, longhouse and fishing village. Every child we fail is potential talent we lose.

The learning environment matters too. Thirty-two percent of students attend schools where principals say infrastructure problems disrupt teaching. Twenty-seven percent report being bullied regularly, compared with 20% across the OECD.
And AI is already in the classroom.
Fifty-six percent of Malaysian students use AI chatbots for learning at least weekly, compared with 46% across the OECD.
The question is no longer whether AI belongs in education. It is whether students can question its answers, detect its errors and resist outsourcing their thinking to it.
Giving students AI without first strengthening their reading and reasoning skills risks producing a generation that can generate fluent answers without knowing whether they are true.
Malaysia needs a national education recovery plan with measurable targets, public accountability and consequences for failure.

Foundational literacy and numeracy must be strengthened from the earliest years. Teachers need sustained professional development. Disadvantaged schools need targeted support, not simply equal funding.
Parents must be partners. Employers should have a voice in the skills we develop. Universities cannot be expected to repair foundations that schools failed to build.
Above all, political leaders must stop treating education as speech material.
Pisa 2025 is a warning. Malaysia’s future will not be built by slogans, gadgets or glossy policy documents.
It will be built — or lost — in our classrooms.
Our children are not the failure. They are the evidence of what the system has delivered.
Authorities must accept the facts and act with urgency.
And please, dear parliamentarians: wake up.

Umum tahu 'berita gembira' yang Zahid sebut itu berkaitan permohonan pengampunan Najib. Bagaimanapun Bahagian Hal Ehwal Undang-undang Jabatan Perdana Menteri kemudian memaklumkan Yang di-Pertuan Agong Sultan Ibrahim berkenan permohonan Najib ditangguhkan ke mesyuarat akan datang.
Agong adalah pengerusi Lembaga Pengampunan. Pada mesyuarat semalam, Sultan Ibrahim berkenan membebaskan 65 banduan.

Tidaklah saya pasti bila Umno mendapat khabar mengenai penangguhan permohonan Najib -- sama ada sebelum atau sesudah perhimpunan Umno ditangguh untuk solat Jumaat. Yang pasti Umno tidak suka mendapat khabar itu meskipun akur keputusan Agong.

Saya ulangi apa yang sering saya kata menerusi beberapa penulisan terdahulu yakni selagi Umno masih mempertahankan Najib dan menuntut apa yang mereka sifatkan sebagai 'keadilan' buat bekas presidennya itu, selagi itulah majoriti rakyat akan menjauhi Umno. Ini kerana majoriti rakyat berpuas hati bahawa Najib sudah diberi peluang secukupnya melalui setiap lapisan proses pengadilan negara lantas sudah menerima keadilan.

Tentunya, Umno tidak setuju dengan pendapat itu sebaliknya yakin akan menang PRU mendatang. Dalam ucapan dasar presiden sempena PAU 2026, Zahid menzahirkan keyakinan Umno akan dapat mandat untuk membentuk kerajaan menerusi 'Gelombang Biru'. Tidak pula diyatakan dengan jelas sama ada 'biru' yang dimaksudkan itu biru Barisan Nasional yang diterajui Umno atau biru Perikatan Nasional yang diterajui PAS.

Seperti kita tahu PAS pada muktamarnya minggu lalu sudah membuat ketetapan. Ringkasnya begini: "kerusi kami, kami mahu kekalkan, tiada toleransi, negeri kami iaitu SG4 kami mahu kekalkan, negeri lain kami mahu tambah kerusi dan jawatan perdana menteri mesti daripada kami."

Adakah Zahid bersetuju? Saya rasa artikel ini boleh dilihat lanjutan artikel saya yang disiarkan FMT tujuh hari lalu. Dalam ucapan semalam, Zahid merujuk kepada pihak tertentu dengan ungkapan 'cukup-cukuplah' dan 'bagi peluang kepada kami pula'. Tidak perlu jadi pakar politik untuk tahu siapa yang beliau rujuk.

Zahid juga menggesa "cukup-cukuplah guru, dengarlah suara kami dengarlah suara rakyat, wahai guru, cukup-cukuplah, Insya-Allah kami boleh buat lebih baik daripada yang guru buat". Sebelum ini Zahid pernah menyifatkan Anwar Ibrahim sebagai gurunya.

Saya terima bahawa apa yang disuarakan Zahid adalah pendapat Umno. Tetapi apabila beliau bercakap mengenai 'suara rakyat', minda tertanya-tanya sejak bila beliau atau partinya bercakap bagi pihak rakyat?

Pun begitu keyakinan Zahid bahawa partinya boleh menubuhkan kerajaan didorong oleh kejayaan pada PRN Johor dan Negeri Sembilan tetapi dengan kerjasama PAS. Namun di Negeri Sembilan keadaan kerajaan pimpinan Umno masih tidak stabil berikutan krisis adat. Setakat ini Timbalan Presiden Umno Mohamad Hasan, anak jati Nismilan belum memberi ulasan. Ini kita cerita di lain hari.

Bagaimanapun, Mohamad semasa merasmikan persidangan Pemuda, Wanita dan Puteri Umno Rabu lalu berkata Umno tidak boleh bergantung kepada PH atau PN. Adakah beliau maksudkan Umno will go solo pada pilihan raya mendatang? Tidak pula dihuraikan.

Beliau berkata penyatuan Melayu boleh berlaku bila-bila masa tetapi mesti berasaskan 'Rumah Bangsa' anjuran atau yang dipelopori Umno. Lantas saya petik laporan FMT semalam, iaitu penganalisis menegaskan Umno tidak berada dalam situasi untuk buat tuntutan seperti itu.

Bercakap mengenai Umno belum cukup kuat tetapi berlagak sebaliknya saya tertarik kepada satu lagi laporan FMT juga yang disiarkan semalam, bertajuk Zahid masih aset Umno, namun banyak isu 'tertunggak'. Menurut penganalisis, Sivamurugan Pandian, isu yang mencemarkan Umno termasuk kontroversi perbelanjaan Kementerian Kemajuan Desa dan Wilayah yang menterinya ialah Zahid, skandal Tabung Haji dan Felda dan juga krisis berpanjangan di Negeri Sembilan.
Di samping itu dikatakan isu politik lalu Zahid semakin meningkat. Tidak kurang juga pemerhati dan penganalisis berpendapat Zahid adalah liabiliti buat Umno.
Bagaimanapun bagi Khairy Jamaluddin, yang baru diterima semula oleh Umno setelah dipecat tidak lama dahulu, menyifatkan ucapan Zahid semalam sebagai amanat 'prime minister-in-waiting'.

Zahid sejak kebelakangan ini mendesak Anwar mengadakan PRU16 segera. Dalam ucapan dasar presiden semalam, beliau ulangi desakan itu. Kita tahu ini konon untuk keep up the momentum setelah menang di Johor dan Negeri Sembilan. Imbau kembali tahun 2022 apabila Umno desak Ismail Sabri Yaakob, naib presiden Umno yang jadi perdana menteri waktu itu, segera adakan PRU15.

Zahid sering dipetik media membuat tuntutan itu. Sekadar satu contoh saya ambil laporan Astro Awani siaran 27 Ogos 2022 yang memetik Zahid berkata "Bila lagi? Kita konsisten dan istiqamah menuntut (PRU15) kerana kita menghormati mandat rakyat". Sejak dulu beliau gemar mendakwa bercakap bagi pihak rakyat.

Ramai ketua bahagian Umno turut ikut langkah Zahid menuntut PRU15 diadakan pada kadar paling segera. Ini saya petik laporan FMT. Desakan dan tuntutan ini kerana Umno was on a high, dan cukup yakin akan menang pilihan raya. Ismail akhirnya tunduk, diadakan PRU15 pada 19 November 2022.
Apa jadi kepada Umno? Mustahil Zahid tak ingat tapi kalau lupa tanya Ismail.
